messages.en:
{07 14 00}You can use the designs you
create at {ff 00 00 06}Mabel{ff 00 00 00}'s {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 19 00}for
things besides clothes.
{06 00 00 03 04}

Hey, you! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0b 00}Do you know the
designer named {ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00}?{02 00 00 05 06}
Of course!
Who is she?
messages.et:
Hei, sina! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0b 00}Kas sa tead
moeloojat nimega {ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00}?{02 00 00 05 06}
Muidugi!
Kes ta on?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oh, yeah! {01 00 00 0a 00}You can use them
on wallpaper or carpets,
too!
{07 03 00}I can't believe you didn't
know that!{01 00 00 0a 00} You're so
clueless, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ah jaa! {01 00 00 0a 00}Neid saab kasutada
ka tapeedil või vaipadel!

{07 03 00}Ma ei suuda uskuda, et sa
seda ei teadnud!{01 00 00 0a 00} Sa oled nii
mõistmatu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You can even display them
as paintings in your house!{01 01 00}
{07 00 00}But if you're gonna do that,
{07 19 00}you better refine your
technique!{01 01 00} No more chicken-
scratch "art," OK?!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sa võid neid isegi oma
majas seinale panna!{01 01 00}
{07 00 00}Aga kui sa seda teed,
{07 19 00}siis lihvi oma
tehnikat!{01 01 00} Ei mingit kana-
kraapimise „kunsti”, eks?!

messages.en:
{07 1b 00}She's a fashion designer
with huge skills,{01 00 00 0a 00} and an
even HUGER head.
{07 0e 00}Oh wait, that's you. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 00 00}The big
head part, that is. {01 01 00}Anyway,
{ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00}'s pretty fabulous.
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}Ta on moelooja suurte
oskustega,{01 00 00 0a 00} ja veel
SUUREMA peaga.
{07 0e 00}Oot, see oled sina. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 00 00}Suure
pea osas, muidugi. {01 01 00}Igatahes,
{ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00} on päris vapustav.

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}You know, {01 00 00 0a 00}I usually don't
care about anyone else's
opinion.
{07 14 00}But when I have a good
design, I go ask those two
for their opinions.
{07 19 00}They're knowledgeable,{01 00 00 05 00} {07 14 00}and{01 00 00 05 00}
so funny! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 03 00}They do the BEST
{ff 00 00 06}Blathers {ff 00 00 00}impression!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Tead, {01 00 00 0a 00}tavaliselt ei huvita
mind kellegi teise
arvamus.
{07 14 00}Aga kui mul on hea
kujundus, lähen küsin
nende kahe arvamust.
{07 19 00}Nad on asjatundlikud{01 00 00 05 00} {07 14 00}ja{01 00 00 05 00}
nii naljakad! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 03 00}Nad matkivad
{ff 00 00 06}Blathersit {ff 00 00 00}PARIMALT!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Of course,{01 00 00 05 00} it's not as good
as mine, {01 00 00 0a 00}but that's a given,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Muidugi{01 00 00 05 00} pole see nii hea
kui minu oma, {01 00 00 0a 00}aga see on
ju selge, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
